rows.commentary: 0.1: Newman Nyamhuri finds early swing with the new ball, but the delivery starts from leg-stump and veers down leg for a wide.
0.1: Newman Nyamhuri shortens his length and pushes one across the right-hander, but it drifts far too wide for the umpire's call.
0.1: Newman Nyamhuri corrects his line with a shorter delivery angled across the right-hander, leaving Rahmanullah Gurbaz swinging and missing entirely.
0.2: Newman Nyamhuri lands one on a good length angling into the pads, allowing Rahmanullah Gurbaz to nudge it behind square on the on-side for a single.
0.3: Newman Nyamhuri tests Ibrahim Zadran with a delivery just outside off, catching the high part of the bat as the batter looks to drive on the rise toward mid-off.
0.4: Newman Nyamhuri completely loses his radar, spraying a delivery miles outside off to gift another wide.
0.4: Newman Nyamhuri bounces back by pulling his length back and seaming one past the outside edge of Rahmanullah Gurbaz's bat.
0.5: Newman Nyamhuri delivers a short of a good length ball angling across, which Rahmanullah Gurbaz expertly rides and steers toward backward point.
0.6: Newman Nyamhuri fires a fuller ball into the pads that Rahmanullah Gurbaz clips uppishly, just clearing a leaping Brian Bennett at mid-wicket to scamper back for two runs.
1.1: Brad Evans targets a short of a good length channel shaping away, drawing a flailing drive from Ibrahim Zadran that beats the top-edge.
1.2: Brad Evans lands it on a good length just outside off, prompting Ibrahim Zadran forward to punch the ball toward the cover region.
1.3: Brad Evans offers a length delivery outside off, and Ibrahim Zadran presses forward to drill it past the bowler and mid-off to claim the first boundary of the evening.
1.4: Brad Evans lands it on a good length to nip off the seam and strike Ibrahim Zadran flush in front, though the fervent leg-before appeal is rightfully waved away as it drifts down leg.
1.5: Brad Evans finds the breakthrough as Ibrahim Zadran drives with hard hands straight to Brian Bennett, who clings on tumbling backwards at cover to dismiss the batter for 5.
1.6: Sediqullah Atal flashes hard at a fuller delivery outside off, slicing a thick outside edge that Masuku brilliantly halts with a sliding one-handed stop to restrict them to two runs.
2.1: Masuku drops it on a short of a good length just outside off, prompting Rahmanullah Gurbaz to solidly defend the ball directly back to the bowler.
2.2: Dot ball from Masuku to Rahmanullah Gurbaz.
